title: Structure nodes visible in PDF Viewer; Map positions stay accurate
description:
Structure nodes placed in the PDF Viewer were saved but never painted — Viewer mode has no world SVG, and overlays only drew highlight lines. Nodes could also jump to the wrong place in Map Builder because Viewer zoom heal rewrote shared world coordinates (and sometimes corrupted page fractions).

Viewer now draws structure markers in each page overlay using stable page fractions (nrx/nry). Heal only rematerializes from those fractions and no longer overwrites them from absolute coordinates after a resize. Map markers also prefer fractions when painting.

Who is affected: PipeSync PDF Viewer + Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync. Place a node in Viewer — it should appear immediately. Switch to Map Building — markers should sit on the correct pipes.
changeLog: Paint structure nodes in PDF Viewer continuous page overlays.
Stop Viewer zoom heal from corrupting structure-node page fractions.
Map markers prefer nrx/nry so positions stay accurate across Viewer/Map.
Refresh Viewer overlays immediately after placing a structure node.
